item.title: TechEquity Ai Organizes Agentic Engineering and Multi-Agent Systems Workshop in Menlo Park
item.description:
TechEquity Ai Organizes Agentic Engineering and Multi-Agent Systems Workshop in Menlo Park

TechEquity Ai - Silicon Valley hosted an event titled “Agentic Engineering & Multi-Agent Systems: Talks + AI Agent Workshops” in Menlo Park, California. The program featured technical talks and hands-on workshops dedicated to the development of AI agents.

🔍 Overview

The event provided a platform for exploring agentic engineering and multi-agent systems. Hosted by TechEquity Ai - Silicon Valley, the session was part of a broader series of business and technical classes offered in the region.

⚙️ Key details

The event featured the following schedule and location details:

Event Name Date Time Location
Agentic Engineering & Multi-Agent Systems Tuesday, September 29 3 PM - 8:30 PM 135 Constitution Dr, Menlo Park, CA
AI Builders Lisbon Wednesday, September 30 6 PM - 9:30 PM Location TBD

🚀 Availability

Registration for these workshops was managed through Eventbrite.

  • Status: Sales have ended for the Menlo Park event on September 29.
  • Status: Sales have ended for the AI Builders Lisbon event on September 30.

💡 Why it matters

The gathering focused on the technical implementation of multi-agent systems, categorized under business and technical classes for AI builders. The session allowed participants to engage with talks and workshops specifically designed around AI agent engineering.
